text:
91:1. He that dwelleth in the aid of the most High, shall abide under the protection of the God of heaven.
91:2. He shall say to the Lord: Thou art my protector, and my refuge: my God, in him will I trust.
91:3. He will overshadow thee with his shoulders: and under his wings thou shalt trust.
91:4. Thou shalt not be afraid of the terror of the night, nor of the arrow that flieth in the day.
91:5. For he hath given his angels charge over thee; to keep thee in all thy ways.
91:6. Because he hoped in me I will deliver him: I will protect him because he hath known my name.
